author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Step into authentic Azerbaijani village life with a comforting, home-cooked meal 🌶🍲 In this video, we prepare traditional cabbage dolma alongside a rich and hearty shorba, using simple ingredients and time-honored techniques.

The dolma is filled with flavorful meat and rice, wrapped in tender cabbage leaves and cooked to perfection. The shorba simmers slowly, developing a deep, насыщенный broth that warms you from the inside out.

This is true Azerbaijani home cooking — generous, flavorful, and rooted in tradition. A perfect combination of dishes that reflect the warmth of village life and the joy of sharing a meal made with care.
title: Cabbage Dolma & Shorba from Whole Beef Leg 🌶
